name: Radio Player
author: jakejayeden
description: Internet radio playback with station and ICY now-playing metadata for LEDMatrix.

versions.notes: Adds Heart 80s as the built-in default using its public 128 kbps MP3 stream, including fallback for existing installs with an empty stream URL.
Moves playback to the pip-installable miniaudio backend so no separate mpv system package is required.
Initial plugin structure and compact 128x32 display.
